resources.string:
On this app, you can check out the best and most comfortable shoes and shop them in a quick and painless way!

Our app is designed to be used for all kind of publics, and with the best selection of shoes from all ages, styles, colors and more!

Looking for a classic shoe for a formal event, such as business meetings, weedings, proms? We have it!

Looking for something more modern, stilish, slicky? We have it too!



If you get lost or need any kind of support, access the help menu located on the top left menu button with a question mark icon (?).

The next screen is the list of shoes available on the store. Click on one of the shoes to see the details of that shoe.

On the shoe details screen, you can check better images of that shoe, more details about it such as available sizes, colors, pricing, etc.

On that screen you can confirm your choice and put it in the shopping cart.

You can navigate between the screens by using the top left back button and the navigation drawer on main shoe list screen.



Reminder: If you get lost or need any kind of support, access the help menu located on the top left menu button with a question mark icon (?).
